shareText:
Aik Muhabbat Aur was originally announced as an upcoming Pakistani drama on Green Entertainment which will air in 2026 and it quickly became one of the most anticipated projects because it pairs Ahad Raza Mir and Maya Ali together for the first time.

The story is described as an emotional love story that faces challenges and difficult circumstances. Fans are especially excited because both Ahad and Maya are among Pakistan's most popular drama stars, and their first onscreen pairing generated a lot of buzz online. Ahad Raza Mir is a popular Pakistani-Canadian actor known for his natural acting, charming personality, and versatile roles. He is the son of veteran actor Asif Raza Mir and became one of Pakistan's biggest TV stars after his breakthrough performance in Yaqeen Ka Safar. His famous dramas include Meem se Mohabbat, hum tum and ehd e wafa.

Maya Ali is one of Pakistan's most popular actresses. She is known for her beauty, expressive acting, and strong romantic roles. Her recent dramas sun mere dil and old ones like Mann mayal have her winning hearts All credits go to @greenentertainment.official
